name: Teronis' Corpse
summary: On an island in western Ashenvale, Teronis' Corpse lies in Lake Falathim. The night elf scout left Astranaar to find Dartol's Rod and help cleanse the forest.

sections.title: A Scout's Grim Fate
sections.body: Teronis was sent from Astranaar to recover Dartol's Rod. Raene Wolfrunner gave the night elf scout this charge, seeking an ancient relic that could cleanse corrupted woodland magic. Teronis searched the waters of Lake Falathim, but hostile murlocs swarmed the island and killed him. His journal remains there, while the murlocs took the rod's radiant gemstone.

faq.answer: Teronis was a night elf scout sent from Astranaar by Sentinel Raene Wolfrunner. He sought Dartol's Rod, an old artifact meant to cleanse demonic corruption in Ashenvale's soil and waters.
Aggressive murlocs ambushed and killed Teronis as he tried to secure the rod's components in Lake Falathim.
Local murlocs around Lake Falathim scavenged the glowing gemstone that crowned Dartol's Rod after Teronis was killed.

faq.q: Why is recovering his mission so important to Astranaar?
faq.answer: Ashenvale's wildlife and woodland pools suffer from demonic and fel taint. The Sentinels hope Dartol's Rod can cleanse the land or hold back the spreading rot.

angles.text: Finding Teronis fallen in the wilds shows how dangerous Ashenvale has become, even for seasoned Sentinels and scouts.
Honoring Astranaar's fallen scouts means carrying on their unfinished work to cleanse the land of corruption.
